subject.title: fix(gateway): bound connect frame auth.* fields at the protocol schema

question: Should this PR bound all six connect-frame auth fields, and should the boundary be byte-length or ASCII token-shape validation rather than TypeBox grapheme maxLength?
rationale: The fix changes a pre-auth security boundary and can reject existing clients before auth retry handling, so gateway/security owners should confirm both the field set and the permanent protocol contract.

options.title: Fix byte/shape caps and cover all fields
options.body: Require byte-length or ASCII token-shape enforcement plus direct validator tests and proof for all six capped auth fields before merge.

options.title: Narrow to bootstrap/device tokens
options.body: Land only the iterated-token DoS mitigation here and leave shared/runtime token caps for a separately justified protocol decision.

options.title: Accept the current tradeoff
options.body: Merge the grapheme-based caps and runtime-token caps only if owners explicitly accept the remaining security and compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Fix byte/shape caps and cover all fields
recommendation.body: Require byte-length or ASCII token-shape enforcement plus direct validator tests and proof for all six capped auth fields before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history signal across gateway handshake and bootstrap-token behavior, and this is a gateway/security protocol boundary choice.
